- DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes

- Version Control: Git

- CI/CD: Gitlab

- Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

- Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Who are we and why should you join us? 


BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.


As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.


What are we looking for? 


We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.


You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.


What technologies will you work with? 


We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.



- Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis

- Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS

- Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery


We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.


What will you do? 



- You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.

- You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.

- You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.

- You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.

- You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.

- You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.

- You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.

- You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.

- You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.

- You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.

- You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.

- You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.

- You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.


What will you NOT do? 



- You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.

- You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.

- You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.

- You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.

- You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.


Can I work remotely? 


Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.


Requirements 



- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

- Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.

- Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.

- At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.

- Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.

- Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.

- A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.

- Five or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.

- Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.

- Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.

- Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.

- Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.

- Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.


Bonus (Helpful, but not required) 



- Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.

- Experience with React or Next.js.

- Experience modernizing established applications or incrementally replacing legacy systems.

- Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or other fast-moving environment.

- Experience building products in health care, mental health, or another highly regulated or privacy-sensitive field.

- Experience mentoring or supporting the growth of other engineers.


Benefits 



- Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company

- Competitive compensation 

- Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)

- Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage

- 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

- The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love 

- Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive

- An awesome community of co-workers

In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026 . Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

- Jerry's guideline library v1 is live for pilot clinics: it answers only from approved guidelines, cites exact lines, and passes the clinical team's test questions

- Listening mode is piloted with at least one clinic, with every suggestion tracked to show the revenue it recovers

title: Team Lead, Data Migration Services
description:
Retire the ERP

At Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.

In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.

You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.

The Role

- Own the data migration practice end to end: every customer moving to Light from Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage or spreadsheets goes through you and your team.

- Lead, coach and grow a small team of migration specialists, setting priorities across a pipeline of concurrent customer migrations and keeping go-live dates on track.

- Run migrations hands-on when it matters: extracting legacy data, mapping charts of accounts, business partners, open invoices and balances, and reconciling the result back to the source system.

- Build and maintain the source-system connectors and migration flows that power our Zero Day Implementation offering, so a new customer’s records can be converted into Light in hours, not weeks.

- Use AI and automation to speed up mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, and turn repeated manual work into productised, self-serve tooling with Engineering and Product.

- Set the standards: migration methodology, mapping templates, reconciliation checks, data quality rules, and clear scope boundaries (what we migrate, what we don’t, and what’s billable, such as historical documents and attachments).

- Be the expert voice with customers’ finance leaders on migration questions, including multi-entity, consolidation, FX and VAT treatment, and be clear with them when a request would put accuracy or timelines at risk.

- Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with migration scoping, effort estimates and sample migrations for prospects.

- Track and report on migration throughput, time to go-live and data accuracy, and use them to decide where to automate next.

How You Fit Into The Team

As Team Lead, Data Migration Services, you sit at the front door of every Light customer relationship. Implementation Managers own the customer journey; you own getting their history into Light accurately and fast. You’ll partner daily with Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering and Sales, and report directly to the Head of Services.

This is a player-coach role: you’ll lead a small team and still roll up your sleeves on the hardest migrations and connector builds. Your biggest mandate is making “zero day conversion” real: run the records first, then run the processes.

Your Qualifications Could Be

- You have personally delivered at least one full accounting system migration through go-live and sign-off (for example Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or NetSuite into a new platform). This is a must.

- Around 5 years in ERP data migration, finance systems implementation or accounting technology, including some time leading people or a workstream.

- Hands-on experience with at least two of Xero, QuickBooks Online, NetSuite or Sage as a source system.

- Strong accounting fundamentals: you understand double entry, trial balances, AR/AP subledgers, multi-entity, multi-currency and UK VAT, and can reconcile to the penny.

- Technical depth to build, not just configure: comfortable with REST APIs, OAuth, SQL, and scripting (Python or TypeScript) for extraction and transformation.

- Practical, evidenced experience using AI tools to speed up data mapping, cleansing or migration work.

- Experience designing repeatable ETL processes, mapping templates and data validation checks.

- A clear, confident communicator with finance leaders, who can explain when a request isn’t sound and suggest a better way.

- Able to manage many concurrent migrations while keeping quality high, with the support of a team you’ll shape.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

- A background as an accountant, auditor or finance systems consultant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar).

- Experience building or maintaining integrations with accounting platform APIs (Xero, QBO, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteQL).

- Exposure to IFRS, UK GAAP, consolidations, intercompany and revenue recognition.

- Experience at a SaaS or fintech company turning services work into product.

- Familiarity with workflow automation tools like n8n.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary plus equity.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Final Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

If you love clean data, hate month-long implementations, and want to build the team that makes switching to Light effortless, we’d love to hear from you at Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀

description:
About Rivia 

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role 

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of user‑facing product experiences that make complex clinical trial data intuitive, actionable, and delightful. You will own major parts of our web application, from frontend architecture and UX to integration with backend services, while remaining comfortable contributing across the stack when needed. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and data teams to ship high‑quality features iteratively and help shape the future of our platform.

To succeed in this role, you should have a passion for iterative product development and possess a strategic, analytical mindset. You should be comfortable navigating the uncertainties of a startup environment, adaptable to shifting priorities, and driven to transform the pharmaceutical industry. Embrace the challenge of building the future of clinical trial technology and help realize Rivia's vision of becoming the definitive unified data infrastructure for clinical trials.

Our stack 

Some technologies we use today: Typescript & React (must-haves for this role), Java, Python, Spring, Postgres, GPT-4, AWS, Kubernetes.

There's no need to be a prior expert in our stack; it's more important that you learn new technologies quickly.

What excites you

- Owning features end‑to‑end on the frontend, from initial idea and technical design through implementation, testing, and rollout.

- Collaborating with design and product to refine UX, interaction patterns, and visual polish.

- Occasionally working across the full stack (APIs, data models, cloud services) to unblock frontend work and ship complete product slices.

- Leveraging the latest advancements in technology, particularly in AI, to develop great products.

Responsibilities 

- Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of core frontend systems and user interfaces for our clinical trial data platform.

- Build robust, accessible, and responsive React/Typescript applications that integrate seamlessly with our backend services and data infrastructure.

- Work across the stack when required (e.g., defining APIs, adjusting backend endpoints, or working with cloud services) to deliver end‑to‑end features.

- Provide technical leadership, helping to design scalable architectures that can support our growth to a multi‑million‑dollar business.

- Address and resolve performance and scalability challenges, both in the frontend and, when needed, in the broader system.

- Level up your teammates by providing mentorship and guidance

- Coordinate closely with sales and customer success teams to ensure technical developments align with customer needs and business objectives

What Excites us

- Previous experience working in a startup environment

- Minimum four years of relevant experience

- A proven track record of taking initiative and leading projects or teams

- Drivers, not passengers

- Excellent problem-solving abilities focused on delivering practical and timely solutions

Hiring Process 

Our hiring process takes 2-4 weeks over four distinct stages:

Our Values

If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. 

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. 

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists 

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own 

- Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

- The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

- The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

- Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

- The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

- The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work 

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year 

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for 

- You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

- You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

- You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

- You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

- You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

- You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

- You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

- English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out 

- You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

- You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

- You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

- You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team 

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts 

- Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

- Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

- Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

- Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

- Pensum: 100%

- Start: As soon as possible

- Language: English; German a plus

- Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply 

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Rematiq helps healthcare and life sciences companies move faster through complex regulatory and quality workflows with AI. Our mission is to reduce the complexity that slows medical innovation down and help more products reach patients faster.

We already work with leading healthcare and life sciences companies, including Novartis , solving real regulatory and operational problems in a highly complex industry.

As a Technical Program Manager, Regulatory Monitoring , you’ll own our Regulatory Monitoring product area end-to-end, combining hands-on technical ownership with product, team, and customer leadership. You’ll help build and lead a small team of engineers, set priorities and technical direction, and remain deeply involved yourself — reviewing code, debugging production issues, and shipping fixes when needed.

Regulatory Monitoring tells our customers what regulators published overnight. It monitors more than 70 regulatory sources across the EU, the US, China, and other markets, captures new and changed guidance, legislation, decrees, and consultations, and delivers them into the customer’s Regulatory Inbox. You’ll work directly with regulatory affairs teams at pharma and MedTech customers to turn their needs into a clear roadmap and make sure coverage, data quality, and reliability stay high. What you'll do

- Own monitoring end to end: Turn customer needs and coverage gaps into priorities, specs and shipped sources, and answer for the coverage, reliability and relevance of what reaches the inbox.

- Lead customer alignment: Join customer calls, maintain the source list per customer, clarify scope, and separate what is included from what is an upsell.

- Lead the scraping team: Set priorities for two engineers, one on architecture and infrastructure and one on sources and features, and write the tickets and specs they build from.

- Stay hands-on: Review pull requests, debug failed production runs, and ship a fix yourself when that is the fastest way.

- Shape the roadmap: Decide what gets built next, including news feeds, ontology-based filtering and classification, and alerts when a regulator changes its site and a scraper breaks.

- Scale source building with AI agents: Improve the agent workflow that builds sources so the team adds more sources per week and more of them pass review the first time.

- Build the team: Help grow the Regulatory Monitoring engineering team and set a high bar for technical quality, ownership, and delivery.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a technical owner with product judgment, customer presence and the ability to read and write code.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

- Relevant background: 2+ years in product leadership (Founder, Head of Product/Engineering or similar) and at least 3 years of hands-on coding as a software engineer, ideally on a data product.

- Hands-on technical depth: You read a TypeScript pull request and judge whether it is correct, understand a Node.js and PostgreSQL service well enough to debug a failed production run, and can ship a fix yourself.

- End-to-end product ownership: You have owned a product with paying customers from scoping through prioritization and requirements to operations, and were measured on outcomes rather than on tickets closed.

- Strong customer presence: You run calls with enterprise customer teams independently, manage scope and expectations, and say no when a request is out of scope.

- Team leadership: You have set priorities for engineers, defined the requirements they built from and reviewed their work. Hiring experience is a plus.

- AI-native working style: You work with coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and have a view on how to make agent-built code reliable.

- Operational discipline: You notice a failed nightly run before the customer does, and you put monitoring and alerts in place so that this does not depend on you.

- Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

- Have built or operated web scraping, crawling or data ingestion pipelines at scale.

- Know regulatory affairs or quality management, ideally in Pharma or MedTech.

- Have been a founder or a very early employee and can show founder-like ownership.

Why Join Rematiq? 

- Real Ownership: You will own a strategic product area end-to-end

- Agent-First Engineering: You’ll work at the frontier of how software gets built when agents become part of the core loop

- Direct Business Impact: Your work will shape product direction and drive real revenue

- Meaningful Mission: You’ll help leading healthcare companies move faster — and support more medical innovation in the process

- Strong Customers: We already work with leading healthcare companies, including Novartis

- Small Team, High Agency: You’ll work closely with founders in an ambitious, execution-focused environment

- Tools That Match the Ambition: Large token budget, real freedom to experiment, and the chance to push modern coding agents to their limits

- Compensation: Competitive salary and meaningful equity

title: Senior Engineer
description:

Vantage is hiring a Senior Engineer. In this role you'll focus on building features and integrations with partner systems while acting as a subject matter expert and mentor for our engineering team. Expect heavy use of external APIs to pull data, as well as designing and delivering APIs that both receive data from and push data to external sources. Minimum Requirements

6+ years of professional experience with a strong record in software development, testing, software design, and architecture.

Advanced SQL expertise beyond an ORM user. Comfortable reading DB queries, designing indexes, tuning complex joins, and refactoring queries for reliability and speed.

title: Mobile Developer
description:
Introduction 

The digital customer journey at Wellis is growing rapidly and becoming more complex. To take it to the next level, we're looking for a Mobile Developer (iOS & Android). You will own everything that touches our mobile experience - from the very first app open to long‑term retention. With your knowledge of native iOS and Android development, mobile UX, and connected health features, you'll make the Wellis app smarter, more personal, and truly engaging. It's time for an experienced mobile specialist to raise our app experience to benchmark level in the healthcare and wellness world.

About Wellis 

Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up that is reinventing one of the most traditional sectors: healthcare. What started just three years ago has already grown into a company with tens of thousands of customers, and we are only at the beginning. By combining medical expertise with technology and data, we make healthcare smarter, more efficient, and more personal.

Our mission is to improve everyday lives by making care accessible, personal, and seamless. Through our platform, people can take control of their health journey with trusted medical support, smart digital tools, and tailored programs. We move fast, challenge conventions, and build solutions that truly make an impact, because we believe better healthcare should be within everyone's reach.

About the Role 

As a Mobile Developer, you'll take the lead in shaping the next generation of the Wellis app. You'll translate designs into seamless native experiences across iOS and Android, integrate smart health features, and build the foundation for a scalable, content-rich wellness platform. Your job is to ensure the Wellis app feels intuitive, personal, and genuinely supportive throughout the user's health journey — far beyond a simple e-commerce transaction.

Key Responsibilities 

- Take end-to-end ownership of the Wellis app - from first MVP to a mature, scalable product.

- Translate UX/UI designs from Figma into high-quality, native iOS and Android experiences.

- Design, build, and maintain complex app features around health, wellness, and coaching - far beyond a simple e‑commerce checkout.

- Integrate with Apple HealthKit, Google Fit, wearables, and other device capabilities to create smart, data-driven user journeys.

- Collaborate closely with backend engineers to connect the app to our GCP-based, API-first platform.

- Implement localization and multi-market capabilities so the app can scale across countries and languages.

- Ensure app performance, reliability, and security, especially around sensitive health data.

- Act as a sparring partner for product, UX, and C-level on mobile strategy, roadmap, and technical choices.

About the Team 

You'll report directly to the CTO, who brings deep experience in building scalable digital platforms and high-impact mobile products. You'll work closely with our UX/UI partners, backend engineers, data team, and medical & customer care teams — with plenty of room to take initiative yourself. As we're building our mobile capabilities from the ground up, the product & tech domain is growing fast, and you'll have the opportunity to play a key role in shaping our mobile app vision and future mobile team.

Who You Are 

- At least 3-5years of hands-on experience in native mobile app development, with proven expertise in both iOS (Swift) and Android (React Native).

- Deep experience building and shipping complex, content-rich, highly interactive apps (beyond basic e‑commerce/check-out flows).

- Experienced in integrating mobile apps with cloud backends and APIs (preferably GCP, but AWS/Azure experience is welcome).

- Comfortable working with design tools and workflows (e.g. Figma) and translating UX/UI concepts into smooth native mobile experiences.

- You are an early AI adapter and know how to leverage AI in your work.

- Combine strong engineering craft with a product mindset: you think in terms of user journeys, personalization, and long-term scalability.

- Strong collaborator and communicator across multiple disciplines (product, design, data, medical/clinical, customer care).

- Fluent in English; experience in healthtech, wellness, or other data-sensitive domains is a plus.

- We are looking for a builder mindset (Someone who has made his own App) 

What We Offer 

- Salary range €5.000 - € 8.000 gross per month (depending on experience)

- Pension plan

- Learning budget

- Monthly personal budget (Alleo)

- Hybrid working: partly from our new office in central Rotterdam (2 days)

- 20 days of remote working per year

- Working from home allowance (2 days a week)

- A culture of short lines, speed, and continuous improvement — where pragmatism and impact matter.

- The opportunity to help build a fast-growing healthtech scale-up from the inside.

Hiring Process 

We want the application process at Wellis to be fast, transparent, and personal. Here's what to expect:

- Application via our website – leave your details and we'll be in touch shortly.

- Introductory chat with Georgios (Recruiter) – an informal online call to get to know you and answer your questions.

- Interview with Karthik (CTO) – a deep-dive conversation about the role, your experience in mobile development, and Wellis' ambitions with our app.

- Technical case & discussion – you'll walk us through apps you've worked on, dive into architecture and technical choices, and explore how you would approach our wellness and health journey on mobile.

- Final conversation with the founders – a closing meeting where you'll hear more about the bigger Wellis story, our product vision, and feel whether this is the right place for you.

We keep the process compact and clear: you'll always know what to expect and truly get to know our team before making your decision.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

- 
Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

- 
Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

- 
Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

- 
Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

- 
Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

- 
Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

- 
Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

title: Cloud Systems Administrator
description:
Headquarters: 

URL: https://oneimaging.com 

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do: 

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first) 

- Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.

- Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.

- Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.

- Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

- Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.

- Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.

- Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.

- Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

- Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.

- Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.

- Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

- Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.

- Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.

- Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

title: Integration Engineer, ERP

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

BLP only works when it talks to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for our customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You'll take ownership of integrations across ERPs such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS and abas, and help us connect to the next one.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, OData, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go fast, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience writing production code in Go.

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in ERP systems: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Experience with both cloud and on-premise ERP environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access or API rate limits in cloud ERPs).

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role 

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it.

It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.

For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.

The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most.

What You Will Learn to Understand 

Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. To answer them, you will build real intuition for:

- How LLMs actually behave : tokens and context windows, sampling and non-determinism, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, system prompts, and why models from different providers react differently to the same input.

- Agents, tools, and retrieval : how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break.

- Cloud software in production : APIs, authentication and SSO, rate limits, latency, integrations, multi-tenant enterprise setups, data residency, and access control.

- Inference and compute : what happens when a request hits a model, why throughput, latency, and cost trade off against each other, and how running our own inference changes what we can offer customers.

- Daily operational tasks : resolving billing issues, reporting bugs and being the point of for our customers.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who cannot stop asking why until you do.

How the Year Works 

Onboarding: Learn the platform by supporting it. You go through an intensive onboarding into our products, the underlying models, and the support queue. You shadow your first tickets, get to know our systems, and start resolving real customer issues. Expect plenty of experimenting, plenty of questions, and a steep learning curve.

Post-Onboarding: Own the queue and take on sidequests. Alongside the queue, you start picking up work from other teams: tasks below the threshold for a specialist to own but too valuable for your learning to ignore. This includes taking a sales call for a new lead, running a short customer workshop, building customer use cases, writing internal documentation, building internal agents, and further building out our own AI support tooling. As our inference and cloud offering grows, you will increasingly help customers understand and adopt it.

What You Will Do 

- Front-line customer support. Spend most of your day in the queue, handling customer tickets end-to-end across model behavior, API integrations, enterprise compliance, billing, and access control.

- Investigate what is happening under the hood. Reproduce issues, compare model behavior, read logs and API responses, and separate "the model did something unexpected" from "the system did something wrong." Then give users clear, empathetic, and accurate answers.

- Explain AI to the people who use it. Help customers understand non-determinism, model limits, context handling, latency, and model choice in plain language, so they can use AI with confidence.

- Take on cross-team sidequests. Pick up the real work that falls between teams, like a small inbound sales call, a customer workshop, a piece of documentation, or an internal automation. These tasks are small in scope, but you fully own them.

- Escalate to engineering and product. Flag recurring user friction, document edge cases with clear reproduction steps, and report bugs directly to the engineers building our platform and infrastructure.

- Improve support with AI. Propose practical improvements to our support workflow and build and test the internal AI tooling that helps resolve routine questions faster.

What Graduation Looks Like 

You start on a 12-month fixed-term contract. The program is designed so that strong performance turns into a permanent contract in a business department that suits your strengths: AI Adoption Management, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Recruiting, RevOps, Operations, Solutions Engineering, or elsewhere in the Business team.

We are expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do , with chat, agents, meetings, code, and apps; and down the stack , into our own cloud, compute, and inference. Wherever you land, you will bring something rare: a deep, hands-on understanding of how AI and AI infrastructure actually behave for real customers.

We make the decision together based on your performance in the queue, how you handled sidequests, and whether the team you want to join has a role for you. So far, AI Associates have graduated into Account/AI Adoption Management, Sales and Solutions Engineering. We are looking to broaden the program as a gateway into all business functions.

You Might Be a Fit If… 

- You are fascinated by how AI works. You have gone down rabbit holes on why models behave the way they do, and you want a job where that curiosity is the core of the work.

- You want to understand the stack, not just the surface. Cloud software, APIs, and inference interest you, and you are excited to learn how models are served, scaled, and made fast and reliable.

- You are genuinely excited about front-line AI support. You take pride in helping customers, write with patience and clarity, and enjoy working through a busy ticket queue.

- You think in systems and love analysis. You enjoy breaking down tricky technical or operational problems and figuring out what is really happening under the hood.

- You show high agency and full ownership. You see a ticket through from first message to resolution and dig into root causes so the same issues do not keep coming back.

- You experiment constantly. You try new models, automations, and tools, and you instinctively look for ways technology can make work easier.

- You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus and useful in the queue.

- You are kind and care about the people around you. 

What We Need 

- Availability to start full-time and work 100% on-site at our Berlin office for the full 12 months.

- A work permit for Germany.

- Technical or analytical grounding. Studies or hands-on experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or a track record of building technical projects, is a plus but not a requirement. Curiosity about how AI and cloud systems work is.

The Environment 

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

Compensation 

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next Steps 

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If you want to spend a year truly understanding AI, from the conversation down to the compute, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity

title: Backend Software Engineer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own 

- 
Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

- 
Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

- 
Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

- 
Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

- 
Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

- 
Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

- 
Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

What We're Looking For 

- 
3+ years of backend engineering experience.

- 
Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

- 
Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

- 
Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

- 
Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

- 
Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

- 
Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want 

- 
Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

- 
Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

- 
Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

- 
Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

- 
Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

This Role Is Not For 

- 
Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

- 
People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

- 
Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

- 
Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

- 
People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Bei der EWERK Consulting GmbH verbinden wir Technologie, Business und Menschen. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, digitale Lösungen nicht nur zu planen, sondern erfolgreich umzusetzen. Dabei setzen wir auf pragmatische Ansätze, moderne Technologien und Teams, die Verantwortung übernehmen.

Ein Teil unserer Projekte findet in Umgebungen statt, in denen Ausfälle keine Option sind: Betreiber kritischer Infrastrukturen (KRITIS) in Energie, Versorgung und öffentlicher Verwaltung. Systeme, auf die sich Menschen jeden Tag verlassen, ohne je darüber nachzudenken. Verfügbarkeit ist hier kein SLA-Wert in einer Tabelle, sondern der eigentliche Zweck der Arbeit.

Für uns bedeutet DevOps mehr als Tools und Prozesse. Wir suchen Menschen, die automatisieren, beraten und gestalten wollen – und die mit Entwicklern (m/w/d) genauso gut sprechen können wie mit dem Betrieb beim Kunden.

Deine Mission 

- Du baust und betreibst die Plattformen, auf denen unsere Lösungen laufen: Container-Infrastruktur, Deployment-Pipelines, Konfiguration, Automatisierung.
- Du machst Systeme beobachtbar und belastbar: Monitoring, Logging, Tracing, Alerting – und ziehst aus dem, was du siehst, die richtigen Schlüsse.
- Du triffst Infrastruktur- und Betriebsentscheidungen, dokumentierst sie und vertrittst sie gegenüber Team und Kunde.
- Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) für den Kunden in allen Fragen rund um Betrieb, Sicherheit und Skalierung.
- Du bringst Entwicklungsteams bei, wie man betreibbare Software durch Reviews, Standards und Mentoring baut, statt durch Vorschriften.
- Du automatisierst Prozesse, auch mit KI-Unterstützung, wo sie tatsächlich etwas bringt.

Darauf freuen wir uns 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d), Platform Engineer (m/w/d) oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
- Container und Infrastruktur: Docker und Kubernetes im produktiven Einsatz; Infrastructure as Code (Terraform oder vergleichbar), GitOps-Ansätze und reproduzierbare Umgebungen sind dir nicht fremd.
- Automatisierung statt Handarbeit: CI/CD-Pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps o. ä.) und Scripting, zum Beispiel in Python, Bash oder Go.
- Cloud-Erfahrung, ergänzt um Verständnis für On-Premises- und hybride Umgebungen.
- Ein gutes Gespür dafür, was in Produktion passiert: Monitoring und Logging im Alltag genutzt, Störungen analysiert, Ursachen gefunden.
- Sicheres Auftreten im Austausch mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und interdisziplinären Teams.
- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Was dich bei uns erwartet 

- Plattformen mit echter Relevanz: Systeme, deren Verfügbarkeit Konsequenzen hat.
- Gestaltungsspielraum statt Betriebsroutine: Du entscheidest mit, wie wir Dinge bauen und betreiben.
- Ein Team aus technischen Experten (m/w/d) und Architekten (m/w/d) mit kurzen Wegen und hoher fachlicher Dichte.
- Eine klare Perspektive Richtung Architekturrolle begleitet durch Mentoring und Weiterbildung in der Arbeitszeit.
- Reisetätigkeit im überschaubaren Rahmen. Wir sind Berater, aber keine Dauerreisenden.

Unsere Benefits 

- Flexibilität ist unser Motto - Office, remote, Homeoffice oder Workation in der EU? Entscheide selbst!
- Familienfreundlich - Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten für die optimale Work-Life-Balance.
- Gut versorgt am Arbeitsplatz - Bei uns erhältst du selbstverständlich kostenlos Kaffee, Tee, Limonade, frisches Obst und die Möglichkeit, in unserer modernen Cafeteria zu kochen.
- Nachhaltige Mobilität - Mit dem JOB-Ticket sowie JobRad inkl. Fahrradgarage unterstützen wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität und bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv fortzubewegen.
- Deine Entwicklung im Fokus - Dafür bieten wir dir maßgeschneiderte Entwicklungsmaßnahmen und regelmäßige Mitarbeitergespräche.
- Technik, die sich nach dir richtet - Wähle dein bevorzugtes Gerät (MacBook oder Windows-Laptop) und erhalte zusätzlich ein Firmenhandy für moderne, mobile Zusammenarbeit.
- Teamspirit und Spaß - Freue dich auf Team- und Firmenevents, bei denen du deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen besser kennenlernen und gemeinsam Spaß haben kannst.
- Fit und aktiv bleiben - In unserem hauseigenen PUMPWERK kannst du dich fit halten, an Kursen teilnehmen oder deinen eigenen Kurs gestalten. Und das sogar in deiner Arbeitszeit, denn eine Stunde pro Woche darfst du für Sport nutzen!
- Deine Gesundheit zählt - Ergonomisches Arbeiten mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen, regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, unser hauseigener Fitnessraum, Karenztage und Besuche der Betriebsärztin sorgen für dein gesundheitliches Wohlbefinden.

Fragen zur Stelle? 

Melde dich gerne bei deiner Ansprechpartnerin im ----- lebt von Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit ganz verschiedenen Geschichten und Perspektiven. Alle personenbezogenen Formulierungen in der Stellenanzeige sind daher geschlechtsneutral zu betrachten. Potenzial ist bei uns willkommen, unabhängig von Identität oder Hintergrund.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Home Energy)
description:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating.

You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform.

In this role, you will:

- 
Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC.

- 
Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on.

- 
Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal.

- 
Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation.

- 
Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations.

- 
Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build.

- 
Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack.

- 
Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions.

Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it.

This role will be right for you, if:

You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes.

Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring: 

- 
Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems.

- 
AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast.

- 
Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance.

- 
Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights.

- 
Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together.

- 
Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

- 
A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates.

Nice to have:

- 
Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling.

- 
Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems.

- 
Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms.

- 
On-call or incident response experience.

What we offer:

- 
Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

- 
A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

- 
Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

- 
Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

- 
Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

- 
Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

- 
Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

- 
Flexible, human-first culture.

- 
Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

- 
Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

- 
Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: Staff Field Engineer | US | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

The Field Engineering team works closely with our Presales Solution Engineering team, as well as Product and Marketing, to ensure the SE's have the tools, collateral, enablement and experts they need to close business. If you've ever served in a Technical Presales role for a software company, you know just how much knowledge you are expected to have, demos you need to show, workshops you need to execute on, etc. The Field Engineering team maintains the backend systems, content creation and deep subject matter expertise that enables the Solution Engineering team to scale and focus on direct customer selling, community building, learning, and other adoption and revenue-focused activities. As a Staff Field Engineer, you are viewed by Sales and FE leadership as being in the top 20% of the field team, operating with little to no supervision on the company's most strategic engagements and serving as a mentor to Senior Field Engineers and Solution Engineers.

What You'll Be Doing:

- Advise on and support some of Grafana's most strategic deals and customer engagements, collaborating with Solution Engineers and Observability Architects on the company's most complex technical challenges with no supervision. 

- Serve as a company-recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) in one area of the Grafana Platform, and deep knowledge across multiple Grafana technologies, building new reference architectures from scratch and overcoming competitive objections in the field

- Proven ability to craft and deliver compelling value based stories to help the sales team technically close deals.

- Own end-to-end creation and curation of technical training content (workshops, how-to guides, demo scripts) for one or more product areas, and establish a repeatable content review cadence in partnership with Enablement and Product Management to keep materials aligned with the product roadmap

- Architect, engineer, and maintain a live production environment that supports demo, workshop, and POV infrastructure at scale, ensuring reliability, security, and uptime.

- Act as a key influencer in product direction, helping key customers adopt newer technologies, and represent Field Engineering in Product planning cycles to surface enablement gaps and shape investment priorities

- Serve as a presenter for Strategic Marketing events (presentations, panels, webinars, conferences, blogs) as an ambassador for Grafana

- Provide technical guidance for a specific product area to Solution Engineers, Observability Architects and customers, and present best practices to customers

- Help update and improve product documentation, and contribute back to the organization through white papers, blogs, and product direction input

- Mentor Senior and Staff Solution Engineers and Field Engineers

What Makes You a Great Fit:

- Minimum of 8+ years of related technical experience, including 2+ years in a Senior Field Engineer role (or equivalent), serving as a SRE, Developer, Architect and/or successful presales Solution Architect. OSS development experience is a plus.

- Excellent understanding of Grafana and associated technologies, with recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) depth in at least one area of the Grafana Platform; deep working knowledge across multiple technologies in the Observability space (e.g. Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Tempo, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, etc.)

- Expert-level knowledge in at least one adjacent domain (e.g. IoT, AI/ML) beyond the core observability stack, and demonstrated domain knowledge across the broader Grafana Ecosystem

- Has created and maintained at least one product training asset (workshop, guide, or structured content) that has been adopted by the broader technical field organization

- Demonstrated experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering to produce and maintain field-facing enablement content and influence roadmap priorities

- Comfortable with at least one modern programming language, and a strong understanding of the modern software development lifecycle, including debugging and investigation

- Working familiarity with Linux, including common tools

- Practical experience using AI tools to generate and review code and to accelerate day-to-day tasks, while retaining full ownership of final decisions and quality criteria for the resulting work

- Able to architect a modern application on one of the primary cloud providers (AWS, Azure or GCP), including IaC tools such as Terraform, understanding the tradeoffs between build vs. buy, and the technologies that make up that architecture such as Kubernetes, Docker, Serverless, Microservices and more
