title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data die het verschil maakt 

Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je plek binnen LINKIT 

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.

Wat we vragen 

- 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

- Sterke programmeervaardigheden in talen zoals Python, Scala en SQL.

- Kennis van of ervaring met distributed data processing frameworks/datalakes/orchestrators zoals Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Airflow, dbt, etc.

- Ruime ervaring met production ELT/ETL-pipelines.

- Ervaring met batch/streaming dataverwerking.

- Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

- Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

- Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

- Pré: ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric of BigQuery.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt 

- Salaris tussen €5.700-€7.400 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

- Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

- Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

- 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

- Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

- Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

- Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure 

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

- Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

- Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

- Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Tabea Hensel via 

Over ons 

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Senior Data Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

title: Software Engineer - PlanetScale Postgres
description:
Headquarters: Remote

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

- You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

- You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

- You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

- You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

- You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

- You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

- You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

- You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

- You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

- You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

- 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

- Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

- Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

- Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

- Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

- Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

- Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

- Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $120,000 - $290,000 USD

title: Senior Sales Engineer, France
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers. 

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time. 

In this role, you will: 

- Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.

- Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.

- Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.

- Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.

- Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.

- Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.

- Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.

- Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.

- Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.

- Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.

- 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.

- Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.

- Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

- Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.

- Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.

- Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.

- Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.

- Fluent in French and English

- Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.

- Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.

- Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.

- Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.

- Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).

- Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.

- Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

title: Data Platform Lead
description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Klanten willen zien wat hun leren oplevert, de business wil sturen op cijfers die kloppen en onze AI-ambities staan of vallen met goede data. Daarom zoeken we een Data Platform Lead die het fundament bouwt waar heel Studytube op draait. 

De rol 

Data werkt bij Studytube als hub-and-spoke. Jij leidt de hub: het gedeelde dataplatform binnen Engineering, met infrastructuur, pipelines, het lakehouse en de gedeelde datamodellen. De spokes zitten in de business, van finance en product tot Customer Success en GTM. Zij bouwen de analyses en dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt, vindbaar is en meebeweegt met het product. 

Je rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering en geeft leiding aan de data engineer. Op termijn breiden we het team uit met een analytics engineer. Je bent een player-coach: je zet de koers uit en bouwt zelf mee. 

Wat je doet 

- Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform en de architectuur, en stelt de roadmap op samen met de spokes. 

- Je zorgt voor één versie van de waarheid. De spokes bepalen wat een actieve learner is, jij zorgt dat die definitie één keer gebouwd wordt en overal hetzelfde getal oplevert. 

- Je bouwt het platform als product: self-service, documentatie en heldere afspraken, zodat analisten zelfstandig vooruit kunnen. 

- Je legt het datafundament voor AI, voor features in het product en voor interne toepassingen op bedrijfsdata. Je team bouwt zelf sneller met AI-tools. 

- Je neemt het Databricks-platform over van een externe partij, inclusief een high-security omgeving, en denkt mee over de toekomst van onze stack. 

- Je richt governance in het platform in: toegang, datakwaliteit, lineage, retentie en verwijdering, GDPR-proof. 

- Je weegt verzoeken van de spokes tegen elkaar af en legt je keuzes uit, ook als het antwoord nee is. 

- Je coacht het team, werft mee aan de uitbreiding en spreidt kennis, zodat niets van één persoon afhangt. 

Je hebt eerder een dataplatform opgezet of volwassen gemaakt, het liefst in een scale-up. Je bent technisch diep, maar denkt vanuit je gebruikers: een analist die een tabel niet vindt of niet vertrouwt, is voor jou een platformprobleem. Je legt trade-offs uit aan zowel de directie als een developer. 

Je bent pragmatisch, nieuwsgierig naar wat AI verandert aan het vak en haalt energie uit het laten groeien van anderen. 

Must-haves 

- 8+ jaar ervaring in data, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar als lead van een team of platform. 

- Hands-on ervaring in de hele keten: een cloud data platform en pipelines, en SQL, dbt en Python in productie. 

- Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure. 

- Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code en CI/CD met GitHub. 

- Dimensioneel modelleren, een semantische laag en data governance in de praktijk. 

- Praktische ervaring met AI-tools in data-ontwikkeling of met data voor AI-toepassingen. 

- Stakeholders tot op directieniveau meenemen in een roadmap. 

- Engels op professioneel niveau; Nederlands is een pré. 

- Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB). 

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, data contracts, B2B SaaS of edtech, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen. 

Stack 

Snowflake, Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker. 

Wat we bieden 

- Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data bij Studytube neer te zetten. 

- Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis. 

- 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag. 

- 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube. 

- € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek. 

- LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding. 

- Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest. 

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

- Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

- Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

- Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

- Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

About you

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

- 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

- Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

- Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

- You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

- You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

- You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

- You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

- You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

- You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

Nice to have

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

- Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

- Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or certification requirements

- Hands-on experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or the isolation and deployment topology behind them

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

We have become a market leader in Bitcoin security and Layer-2 technologies. Our products are designed to make financial systems more efficient, secure, and robust.

We're seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer embedded directly inside customer engineering teams, writing the code, building the tooling, integrations and configurations needed to get Blockstream's products into production. Additionally you ship what you build back into the core product.

Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Forward Deployed Engineer partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Delivery teams to help customers successfully implement and adopt Blockstream's products.

This is not a traditional configuration or support role. You will spend significant time working directly alongside customer engineering, operations, and technology teams, often onsite, to understand complex banking environments, solve technical challenges, and deliver production-ready solutions. As the technical bridge between customers and Blockstream, you will play a critical role in accelerating customer success while providing valuable implementation insights that continuously improve our products and delivery methodology.

What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities): 

Customer Delivery & Implementation

- Tech Pre-Sales: Support Enterprise Sales in technical pre-sales, RFP/RFI and security questionnaire responses; contribute to SOW scoping, effort estimation, and scope-change management.

- Delivery: Own the technical delivery of Blockstream enterprise software from project kickoff through production deployment and post launch support

- Financial Institutions: Work directly with financial institutions to understand business processes, operational workflows, and technical environments.

- Configure, deploy, and optimize Blockstream products based on customer requirements and approved solution designs.

- Success Criteria: Execute implementation planning, system configuration, testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployment, and post-go-live support. Define success criteria, milestones and own implementation.

- Deliver administrator and end-user enablement sessions to ensure successful customer adoption.

- Enterprise integration: Integrate with core banking and capital-markets systems.

Engineering & Technical Delivery 

- Controlled environments: Deploy into on-premise, network-isolated, and air-gapped banking environments under formal change control, producing the security and audit evidence that compliance and pen-test reviews require.

- Design and implement integrations between Blockstream enterprise products and customer systems using required integration interfaces and data pipeline technologies.

- Troubleshoot complex technical, configuration, and integration challenges throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Work closely with customer engineering teams to ensure secure, scalable, and production-ready deployments.

- Develop reusable deployment assets, implementation playbooks, technical documentation, and best practices.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering to resolve product issues and improve implementation quality.

Customer Collaboration 

Embed directly with customer teams to gain a deep understanding of their operating environment and technical challenges.

- Facilitate technical workshops, architecture discussions, and implementation planning sessions.

- Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Build strong relationships across customer Technology, Operations, Security, and Engineering functions.

Digital Assets Product Improvement Feedback Loop 

- Turn implementation learnings, customer feedback, and product enhancement opportunities into code

- Identify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements and contribute to standardized implementation methodologies.

- Partner with Product Management and Engineering to shape the roadmap and improve platform capabilities based on real customer implementations.

- Help accelerate customer time-to-production through continuous improvement of deployment frameworks and best practices.

What We Look for In You (Required Qualifications): 

- 4-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Consulting, Implementation Engineering, or Enterprise Software Delivery.

- Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Rust) sufficient to build and ship integrations, tooling and services independently

- Experience implementing and deploying enterprise software solutions within complex customer environments.

- Strong understanding of protocol intermediation, enterprise integration patterns, cloud technologies, security fundamentals and modern software architectures.

- Experience working directly with enterprise customers throughout implementation and deployment projects.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Comfortable collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Consulting teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Self-starter with proven ability to work independently while managing multiple customer engagements.

- Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations across Switzerland.

- Excellent English skills are required, German and/or French is strongly preferred. 

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications): 

- Experience working with financial institutions, like private banking, wealth management, custody, payments, treasury, or capital markets.

- Background in Bitcoin, blockchain, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

- Experience integrating enterprise software using APIs and modern integration frameworks.

- Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerized deployments, or infrastructure automation.

title: Software Engineer II - Poland

As a Software Engineer II, you bring growing technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of features and components across the product. One of the team’s key projects involves Keycloak, an open-source Identity and Access Management solution. The API team owns and improves the backend API layer that powers the Housecall Pro application, with a strong current focus on application performance and creating a fast, reliable user experience.

In this role, you will elevate team effectiveness by sharing knowledge, contributing to design and code reviews. Our team is passionate, empathetic, and committed to improving the lives of our service professionals, our Pros. Your impact will help strengthen our product, enhance user experiences, and support the long-term success of the people we serve.

You’ll join a small and senior squad focused on cross-cutting search concerns, working closely with Product Platform teams, IAM, DevOps, and SRE. title: Product Engineer
description:

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

The Role

We are looking for a full-stack software engineer to join our engineering team and build our product. You will report to an engineering manager and work in a diverse team composed of a product lead, AI engineers, and other software engineers.

You will be fully responsible for the development of new features in the product, guided by the product team’s focus on business impact. You will do this while maintaining the health of our codebase so that we can keep improving the product as fast as possible.

How is this opportunity different? 

- 
you will work on a product already used in production but still early in its life

- 
you will work hand-in-hand with a product team that cares more about business impact than the number of features delivered

- 
you will join an engineering team of 15 engineers with a strong culture of quality and continuous improvement

Typical projects you could be working on: 

- 
an integration of a service used by sites to manage their patients (called EHR) so that we can assess them against a trial.

- 
build a central experience for site networks that own several sites and allow them to bulk apply to trials and assess patients across their sites.

Salary range: 45k€ - 65k€, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

- 
Build features from beginning to end (design, implementation, deployment, support)

- 
Continuously work on improving the team processes and tools

- 
Share what you learn internally (ex: talk) and externally (ex: blog post)

Qualifications

- 
You can communicate clearly in both written and oral form in English and French

- 
As a full-stack software engineer, you have built and maintained a web product, in a team, in a fast-paced environment for 2 years or more.

- 
You have experience being proactive in your collaboration with product managers and designers, and want to leverage domain-driven design to make it effective.

- 
You are proficient with Typescript, React, and Next.JS

Bonus

- 
You have experience with functional programming, and want to use it in your job

- 
You worked in the healthcare industry

- 
You have experience in a startup/scaleup with a SaaS product

- 
You have faced the challenge of collaborating for several months on a shared codebase, and applied software craftsmanship techniques (TDD, clean code) to increase both pace and quality.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

Benefits

Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

- 
Top-of-the-line equipment

- 
Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

Compensatory time off (RTT)

Lunch vouchers (Swile)

Gym membership (Gymlib)

Free books & learning material

title: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team 

As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions. With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

What You'll Do 

- Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow. 

- Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit

- Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines

- Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isn’t always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

- Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind

- Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't

- Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics

- Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

- Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly

- Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

What You'll Bring 

- Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments

- A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)

- Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

- Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

- Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

- Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

- A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others

- Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same

- Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners

- Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed

- A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals

- Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices

- Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

This Role is a Great Fit If 

- You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows

- You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

- You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work

- You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example

- You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others

- You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it

- You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first

- You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

Applying 

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! 

When applying please include: 

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. 

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com. 

About Netlify 

Netlify is a platform that lets you create, share, and run anything on the web: a website, an app, an agent experience, whatever you can dream up. Use your own tools or ours to build it, collaborate with your team, get it live, and keep it running. Anyone, from people just starting out to seasoned developers, can create pro-level web experiences that really work, really well.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $182,000 - $248,000 for most US-based locations, $175,000 - $235,000 CAD in most Canada-based locations, and £105,000 – £144,000 GBP for most UK-based locations. Candidates outside the US, Canada, UK, or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Who We Are 

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You’ll Do 

We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality.

You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab.

The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next.

Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder.

Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against.

Role and Responsibilities 

- 
0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure.

- 
Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work.

- 
Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4–12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success.

- 
Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints.

- 
Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems than anyone else at Roboflow. You'll surface the gap between what the customer says they want, what they actually need, and what the machine operators on the floor think. That feedback loop back to Product and Engineering shapes what we build next, and it's one of the most valuable things FDEs bring back to the company.

- 
Knowledge Transfer & Handoff: Document your deployment architecture, create runbooks, and train the customer’s team so they can operate the system independently. Provide a clean handoff to Roboflow’s Implementation Engineers for scaling and expansion.

- 
De-risk New Deployments: Identify and resolve technical risks early. If a customer’s environment won’t support the planned architecture, you find the alternative before it becomes a project failure.

- 
Shape the Deployment Playbook: Codify repeatable deployment patterns, starter templates, and reusable artifacts that make future deployments faster and more reliable.

The Skillset You’ll Bring 

- 
Meaningful experience deploying technology in physical-world environments. We value breadth, working across different industries, hardware platforms, and deployment contexts, over depth at a single company. The best FDEs we've hired have built things in factories, warehouses, construction sites, or labs before ever touching a vision model.

- 
Strong proficiency in Python; experience with systems-level work (Docker, Kubernetes, networking, Linux) is highly valued.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying machine learning or computer vision models to production; you understand the gap between a working notebook and a reliable pipeline.

- 
Experience with edge computing hardware and constraints (NVIDIA Jetson, industrial cameras, limited connectivity, on-premise security requirements).

- 
Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills; you’re the person who figures out why it works in staging but not in production.

- 
Strong interpersonal skills - you'll be embedded with customer teams and need to build trust quickly while navigating their internal dynamics. You'll talk to executives, engineers, and machine operators, sometimes in the same meeting.

- 
Experience in one or more of Roboflow’s target verticals: manufacturing, logistics, food processing, automotive, or retail.

- 
Willingness to travel ~40–50% for on-site customer deployments.

Preferred Attributes 

- 
Experience in a professional services, deployment engineering, or forward deployed engineering role.

- 
Familiarity with CV/MLOps tooling and practices (model versioning, monitoring, retraining pipelines).

- 
Deep industrial subject matter expertise. The kind of person who can walk onto a production line and immediately start asking the right questions about throughput, defect rates, and inspection points.

- 
Background in IoT, embedded systems, or infrastructure engineering alongside hands-on deployment experience.

- 
You're a tinkerer outside of work. You own a 3D printer, you've got Raspberry Pis running something in your house, you're constantly tweaking your home network or smart home setup. You enjoy figuring out why something doesn't work as much as you enjoy building it in the first place.

Who You’ll Be Working With 

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be partnering directly with our co-founder/CEO and Sales leadership to not only do great work in the role, but shape how this function works for the future of Roboflow.

Where You’ll Work 

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you’d like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You’ll Work 

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You’ll Receive 

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target base compensation for this role is $180,000–$250,000, with additional equity compensation. 

Compensation and scope of ownership will be determined based on demonstrated capability, expected impact, and the needs of the business.

Target OTE: $ 

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits:

- 
$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

- 
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

- 
$350/mo AI Tools

- 
$150/mo Team lunch

- 
$500/one time Home office

- 
Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

- 
Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (~5 hours) 

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team, who you’ll be speaking directly with about what it’s like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don’t be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a few days.

Before the Interview: 

- 
We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

- 
The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

- 
We may send you a technical screen if applicable.

Introduction Phase: 

- 
[45m] Meet with hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

Team Interview Phase: 

- 
[60m] Technical Assessment - live coding or architecture session

- 
[30m] Demo - build a project with Roboflow and share your work

Final Interview Stage: 

- 
[30m] Meet with Head of Operations, for a culture discussion

- 
[30m] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can. 

Not Sure If This Is You? 

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing “Subscribe” to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

- Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 

- Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.

- Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 

- User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 

- LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer , you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation). 

Responsibilities 

- Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. 

- Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.

- Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models. 

- Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 

- Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. 

- Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. 

- Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.

- Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.

- Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. 

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. 

- Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. 

- Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. 

- Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.

- Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) - Vollzeit
description:
Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) für agentische Softwareentwicklung

Die Kanzlei Prinz ist auf Online-Reputationsrecht spezialisiert: Für über 2.300 Mandanten, überwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen, sorgen wir dafür, dass rechtswidrige Bewertungen auf Plattformen wie kununu, Google und Trustpilot verschwinden. Dabei läuft bei uns alles über unser selbst entwickeltes Case-Management-System.

Software als Grundlage unserer Dienstleistung 

So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum.

Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus.

Warum wir dich suchen 

Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir bieten: 

- Klare Rolle: Eine Fachposition ohne Personalverantwortung – du arbeitest direkt mit dem Kanzleiinhaber zusammen, der deine Sprache spricht. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen.

- Harmonisches Miteinander: Ein eingespieltes, derzeit überwiegend weibliches Team, in dem man sich aufeinander verlassen kann – in hellen, modernen Büros am Mainzer Rheinufer.

- Gleitzeit und gutes Gehalt 

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger mit entsprechenden Fachkenntnissen sind ebenso willkommen

- Erfahrung mit agentischer Softwareentwicklung (z. B. mit Claude Code) – für uns zentral: Du gibst KI-Agenten präzise Vorgaben, zerlegst Aufgaben in überschaubare Schritte und prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch

description:

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Swap 

Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.

Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.

At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.

Our agentic storefront is an AI shopping experience that helps shoppers discover, decide, and buy through natural conversation.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be a technical leader on the team building it. You’ll set direction for several engineering teams, take on the hardest cross-cutting problems, and stay hands-on in the code that matters most. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Data, and engineering leadership to turn ambitious goals into practical plans, and you’ll help the engineers around you do their best work.

Responsibilities 

- Lead large initiatives that run for several quarters and involve multiple teams, from first scoping through to production.

- Write exemplar code in critical paths, setting the implementation bar for the wider group.

- Review important designs from other teams, helping engineers balance quality, speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

- Define and uphold operational standards for the group: monitoring, availability, scalability, security, release safety, and cost awareness. Help lead serious incidents and follow through on the right fixes.

- Lead tool evaluations and architecture migrations, making build-vs-buy trade-offs explicit.

- Use AI well beyond the basics, and push back on AI-generated complexity so code health holds as we speed up.

- Own the business result of your work. Define success metrics, monitor after launch, and challenge constructively when something won’t move the needle for merchants.

- Mentor Senior Engineers and below, and lead or join senior-level interviews.

- Write and improve the documentation others rely on, such as architecture direction, decision records, and runbooks.

Requirements 

- Significant experience (typically 8+ years) building and shipping production software, with a record of leading complex initiatives that cross team lines.

- Deep expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js, including architecting REST and/or GraphQL APIs and distributed systems.

- Comfort outside your home language and stack. We expect Staff engineers to be T-shaped.

- Strong relational database, data modelling, and SQL skills, plus familiarity with NoSQL.

- Experience designing for reliability and scale in the cloud, with solid CI/CD, observability, and incident-response practices.

- Hands-on experience with LLMs or agentic systems, or a track record of picking up new technology fast and applying it sensibly.

- Daily use of AI coding tools, with a sense for when to trust them and when not to.

- Experience in eCommerce systems and platforms is preferred.

- Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain trade-offs in business terms to any audience.

- A team player with a bias for ownership: you bring a solution along with the problem, and work isn’t done until it’s live and stable.

What we offer 

💰 Competitive base salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact you’ll have, reviewed regularly as you grow with us.

📈 Stock options: Own a piece of what we’re building. As a high-growth scale-up, you’ll share in the upside as the company grows.

🏖️ Generous PTO: Competitive annual leave, with public holidays on top, plus your birthday off so you can celebrate properly.

🏥 Private healthcare: Comprehensive private medical cover, so you can get the care you need quickly.

🏦 Pension contributions: Company contributions to help you build long-term financial security.

🧘 Wellness benefits: Support for your physical health and wellbeing, so you can look after yourself in the way that works for you.

💚 Mental health support: Access to mental health resources and support, because looking after your mind matters as much as your body.

👶 Enhanced maternity and paternity leave: Extra support when you’re growing your family, so you can focus on what matters most.

🏡 Flexible working: Choose how and where you do your best work, with the trust and autonomy to manage your own time.

✈️ Work abroad for 4 weeks a year: Take your laptop somewhere new for up to four weeks each year, whether that’s family, travel, or a change of scenery.

🎉 Quarterly team offsite budget: A dedicated budget each quarter for your team to get together, connect, and have fun.

🍻 Thursday happy hour: Wind down the week with your colleagues at our Thursday happy hour, held across all of our locations.

🥞 Breakfast Mondays: Start the week with a good meal and good company.

Diversity & Equal Opportunities: 

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

- 
Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

- 
Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

- 
Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

- 
Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For 

- 
Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

- 
Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

- 
Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

- 
Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

- 
Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

- 
Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For 

- 
People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

- 
Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

- 
Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

- 
People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

- 
Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar 

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria .

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! 

What will you do?

You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: 

li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100">- Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform.

Who are we?

What makes you the ideal candidate? 

For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: 

li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100">- Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself.
